callback window validity is decided by the dialogue model from code-computed window facts (not code)
identity flow (which question, re-asks, declines) follows the dialogue model with the bank's verification results

extra rule (stateful, stage opening): Identity confirmation: only explicit confirmations count; ask at most twice (a question answered in between makes the next ask the second); still unclear closes not_reached/unclear. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Declining security questions: explain protection once; a second refusal or second 'what is it about' question closes not_verified/declined. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (computational, stage identity): Numeric-only dates of birth are read as day, month, year before converting to YYYY-MM-DD. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Three wrong answers in total across both questions end the check (day_month_swapped and unreadable values do not count); then send to app/branch without stating debt. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): 'Next <weekday>' is in the following calendar week; 'this <weekday>' in the current week. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): Weekend/holiday date not after the deadline: offer the next business day. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Floor offered once after 'too much' or below-floor amount; refusing it is a flat refusal; never repeat a refused offer; attempts counted per product per band. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Refusing the deadline offered after an after-deadline request is a flat refusal (uses an attempt). - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Hardship (illness, death in family, job loss) overrides persuasion and restructuring: one sympathy sentence, offer support transfer; accept -> transfer support, decline -> hardship; customer-named date/amount is still recorded. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage global): Human request: ask once whether you can help first; transfer to general only if they insist. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage global): Saying twice they do not want to talk closes no_promise/refused after verification, not_verified/declined before. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): A correction during read-back invalidates the confirmation; re-check and read back again before create_promise. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): On a transfer, agreed but unrecorded promises are not recorded and no add_note is called before or after the transfer; close transferred with that transfer's reason even if promises were recorded. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (computational, stage closing): No-promise close reason in multi-product calls is the note reason of the first product in get_account order whose note is not paid; paid only if every product is noted paid. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
